info.title: Enterprise Knowledge Assistant
info.description:
Enterprise Knowledge Assistant: permission-aware document search and grounded,
cited question answering over an organization's documents.

**Authentication.** `POST /api/v1/auth/login` sets an HttpOnly session cookie and a
readable `eka_csrf` cookie. Send the CSRF cookie's value in the `X-CSRF-Token` header on
every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE. Errors always use the envelope
`{"error": {"code", "message", "details", "request_id"}}`.

get.description: Liveness: the process is serving requests (dependencies are not checked).

Readiness: database reachable and migrated with the configured embedding
dimension, Redis reachable, object storage usable.

post.description:
Create an account and sign in.

With `invite_token` the user joins the inviting organization with the invited role
(the email must match the invitation). Without it a new organization is created with
the caller as organization admin; this requires ALLOW_PUBLIC_REGISTRATION=true (off by
default: then scripts/create_organization.py makes the first organization).
Sets the HttpOnly session cookie and the CSRF cookie.

Sign in with email and password. Unknown emails and wrong passwords return the
same 401 after the same amount of work.

Revoke the current session (when it is valid and the CSRF token matches) and
clear the cookies. Always succeeds, so a stale client can always sign out.

get.description:
The signed-in user, their active organization, organizations they belong to,
accessible workspaces and UI capability hints.

post.description: Change the password (requires the current one). Revokes all other sessions.
Make another organization the caller belongs to the active one for this session.

Upload a document into a workspace (workspace owners/editors and org admins).

The file is validated (extension, declared type and content signature must agree;
size within MAX_UPLOAD_MB), stored, and queued for ingestion. 409 with
`details.document_id` when identical content already exists in the workspace.

post.description:
Knowledge-base search (no LLM): hybrid vector + full-text retrieval fused with
RRF and optionally reranked. Only passages from documents the caller can read are
returned; filters can narrow but never widen that scope. Each result explains why it
matched (per-method ranks/scores and matched terms).

Ask a question; returns the grounded answer with validated citations.

Starts a new conversation unless `conversation_id` (owned by the caller) is given.
Retrieval only sees documents the caller can read, intersected with `scope`.
`answer_status` is `insufficient_evidence` when the documents do not support an
answer.

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

post.description:
Same as POST /chat, streamed as Server-Sent Events (see the 200 response).

Request errors (unknown conversation, invalid scope) are returned as normal HTTP
errors before the stream starts. If the client disconnects, generation stops and
the partial answer is saved with status `incomplete`.

200.description:
Chat contracts, including the Server-Sent Events emitted by POST /chat/stream:

    event: meta     data: StreamMetaEvent      (first; ids for the new messages)
    event: sources  data: StreamSourcesEvent   (passages the answer will be based on)
    event: token    data: StreamTokenEvent     (answer text deltas, many)
    event: done     data: StreamDoneEvent      (final persisted assistant message)
    event: error    data: StreamErrorEvent     (terminal; partial text is persisted)

Comment lines (": keep-alive") are sent every 15s while the model is thinking.

Capabilities.title: Capabilities
Capabilities.description: UI hints only - every action is re-authorized server-side.

ChatScope.title: ChatScope
ChatScope.description: Restrict retrieval to these workspaces/documents (intersected with access).

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: True only if the marker maps to a retrieved source.

redacted.title: Redacted
redacted.description: True when the caller can no longer read the document.

DashboardResponse.title: DashboardResponse
DashboardResponse.description: Counts cover only documents the caller can read.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Present only for callers who can manage the document.

MatchExplanation.title: MatchExplanation
MatchExplanation.description: Why a passage matched: each retriever's rank/score and the fused/reranked score.

is_active.title: Is Active
is_active.description: False once deactivated: cannot sign in

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Retrieval summary: search_query, mode, reranked, timings_ms, usage.

redacted.title: Redacted
redacted.description: True when the answer is withheld (content is empty) because it drew on a document the caller can no longer read, directly or through earlier answers.

organization_name.title: Organization Name
organization_name.description: Required unless invite_token is given (creates a new organization).

SearchFilters.title: SearchFilters
SearchFilters.description:
Narrow the search. Always intersected with what the caller may read; ids the caller
cannot read match nothing. A missing or empty list means no filter.

excerpt.title: Excerpt
excerpt.description: Passage text (null when redacted because access was revoked).

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description: A passage supplied to the model, labelled S1..Sn.

role.description: The caller's workspace role; null for org admins without membership.
